messages:
Harper: Postmortem attached. Need to lock owners for customer-facing follow-ups: (A) concise statuspage blurb, (B) 72h customer briefing for affected accounts + CSM note, and (C) a short RCA-sharing guardrails doc (redaction checklist + intake SLA). Also infra flagged a recurring eviction signal. Can we assign by EOD?
Jon: I can own the 72h customer briefing and the CSM paragraph. Will aim for plain language + an optional technical appendix. ETA: 30h.
Harper: Thanks. Who can do the statuspage blurb? Keep it short, include region/times and contact line.
Mei: I can draft the RCA-sharing guardrails (legal + controls). Plan: tiers (public summary / sanitized RCA / full RCA under NDA), redaction checklist (PII, secrets, raw auth logs, internal IPs), intake process and SLA. ETA: 72h.
Claire: Infra: will take pattern follow-up and run a quick historical search. We saw 5 similar eviction spikes in ~10 weeks. I'll open follow-up ACTION-5310 for detection thresholds & alerts. Owner: infra-ops (me). ETA: 3w for detection tuning, 6w for mitigation rollout.
incident-bot: Created ACTION-5309 and linked postmortem: https://go/reports/ACTION-5309
Harper: Proposed split: Harper=statuspage (ETA +6h), Jon=72h brief (ETA +30h), Mei=guardrails + checklist (ETA +72h), Claire=ACTION-5310 owner for infra pattern (ETA as above). Accept?
Jon: Accept. I'll include a contact line for customers (support@redwood.ai) and a short "how to request more details" blurb (link to internal intake). Proposed SLA: 5 business days for sanitized RCAs.
Mei: For the guardrails: default public = statuspage + 72h brief. Sanitized RCA = redacted technical RCA with clear redaction logs; available on request after legal + infra review. Full RCA = NDA only; must pass redaction review and exec sign-off. I'll include a checkbox-style redaction template.
Harper: Statuspage draft v0 (short):
```
Partial degradation of request throughput for a subset of customers in APAC between 03:18-03:46 UTC. Service restored after failover at 03:46 UTC. We do not have evidence of customer data exposure. Affected customers will receive a direct summary.
```
Harper: Adding contact: support@redwood.ai. Also add tag: "eviction-patterns-v2"?
Claire: Go ahead and add the tag. I'll attach event counts to ACTION-5310. Recommend adding monitoring for eviction rate > X/min (I'll propose a threshold after analysis).
Jon: 72h brief outline: tl;dr, who affected, impact, timeline, immediate mitigation, high-level root cause, next steps (monitoring + mitigation ETA), how to request the sanitized/full RCA, expected review SLA (5 business days). I'll upload draft to ACTION-5309 for review.
Mei: Legal note: sanitized RCAs should include a short section listing what was redacted for transparency. Also include an intake email and an expected review cut-off. I'll add that to the template.
incident-bot: ACTION-5309 updated -> owners assigned: Harper, Jon, Mei. ACTION-5310 created -> owner: Claire.
Harper: Scheduling a 20-min review tomorrow 10:15 UTC to review drafts. Please upload to ACTION-5309 before the sync.
Jon: Will upload 72h draft by 09:45 UTC tomorrow.
Mei: Guardrails skeleton posted to ACTION-5309 within 48h. If infra can confirm which artifacts are exportable earlier that helps.
Claire: Attaching initial incident counts to ACTION-5310 now. Will follow up with a proposed detection threshold within 48h.
Harper: Final EOD checklist: ACTION-5309 has owners + ETAs, statuspage draft posted (Harper), 72h draft planned (Jon), guardrails WIP (Mei), infra follow-up ACTION-5310 for recurring pattern (Claire). If anyone misses their ETA, DM me.
Jon: ack.
Mei: ack.
Claire: ack.
Harper: Thanks everyone  great coordination. We'll close the loop after the review sync. :white_check_mark:
